items.hook: Son of Fury: The Story of Benjamin Blake is a 1942 American south seas adventure film directed by John Cromwell and starring Tyrone Power.
items.body: The film was adapted from Edison Marshall's 1941 historical novel Benjamin Blake. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Last Human is the title of a 1995 science fiction comedy novel written by Doug Naylor.
items.body: It is part of the Red Dwarf series of novels, based on the popular television show created by Naylor and his partner Rob Grant. One of those things you can't un-know.
